author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Neodyme published exploit details for two critical Puppet flaws (fixed by Perforce and OpenVox): CVE-2026-115731 lets crafted agent reports achieve server-side code execution, so a Puppet agent certificate can become a route to the fleet's management server.

author: chris_uk2026
text: Google's November 2026 Android update fixes 23 critical flaws, led by a zero-click RCE (CVE-2026-58868) and an 'SMS of Death' bug. Update devices now.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Hackers breached at least 27 organizations using stolen Microsoft Entra ID application and Azure DevOps credentials in an ongoing cloud intrusion campaign.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: MSP-linked threat actor authenticates as trusted Azure apps, bypassing MFA, to harvest credentials across multiple customer tenants (Todyl: application credential misuse across 533 tenants), first observed Nov 1, 2026.

author: figarlandlavon
text: Japan's leisure booking platform Asoview! disclosed a cyberattack exposing about 15.82 million member records via unauthorized access to an external system.

author: kkaasolutions
text: CVE-2026-97693 (CRITICAL 9.9): Yuxi, a large-model-based knowledge base and knowledge-graph agent development platform, from 0.6.0.beta1 is affected by a critical flaw.

author: infrastack_ai
text: Cloudflare's WAF now blocks PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619) attempts with a rule on every plan including Free, but it is a stopgap for proxied traffic only, not a patch.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: DreamHost confirms data breach: hackers gained unauthorized access to its systems during a months-long cyberattack, stealing customer credentials and accessing email inboxes. Rotate DreamHost credentials.

author: thesystemprompt
text: Cisco Talos: VOLTA infostealer sends stolen credentials, cards and wallet data to an AI model via OpenRouter to rank victims. Default Claude Opus 4.6, fallbacks Kimi K2 and Gemini 2.5 Flash; refusal phrases trigger the next model.

author: f3ssoftware
text: NIKKE supply-chain attack: the publisher confirms PC launcher scripts were tampered with; fix shipped Nov 4. CDN JS altered Sep 27 fetched a RAT stealing browser credentials and wallet data.

author: cyber_watchers
text: Sekoia TDR: large-scale APT29 watering hole campaign targeting iOS and Android users through compromised websites, fake domains and a supply-chain attack; n-day exploits used to steal cookies, Wi-Fi passwords and device data.

author: moftahlmabry
text: 948 ways to get root on Linux, found by AI in one run. OpenAI says a pipeline running an unreleased cyber model reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel bugs. It then built 948 distinct local privilege-escalation exploits, each with a candidate patch, for $1.21M in API credits.

author: gurvrx
text: Ivanti Connect Secure = ROOT in the wild. 3 chained zero-days, actively exploited by UTA0576: CVE-2026-104935 (unauth RCE 8.6), CVE-2026-111357 (priv-esc to root 8.8, CISA KEV), CVE-2026-118527 (file upload, deadline 11/13)

author: SockAnalystHQ
text: WordPress core CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS 8.1) is actively exploited. CISA added it to KEV Nov 3, federal deadline Nov 6. During a full core update, 4.7 to 7.1.3 stage the installer in a predictable public folder that attackers race for no-login RCE. Fix: 7.1.4 or a backport.

author: techyoutbe
text: More than 1,000 exposed GitLab instances were reported unpatched against actively exploited CVE-2026-97229, a CVSS 10.0 RCE vulnerability fixed in versions 19.2.8, 19.3.5 and 19.4.2.

author: LifeboatHQ
text: CISA Adds Actively Exploited GitLab RCE and Cisco Firewall DoS Flaws to KEV

author: k_kueck
text: Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418: an unauthenticated attacker can crash your remote-access VPN. It's actively exploited and on CISA's KEV list; federal patch deadline was Nov 1.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2024-27834: Apple Pointer Authentication Bypass Actively Exploited. On November 4, 2026, CISA formally added CVE-2024-27834 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical, partly patched: Node-RED missing adminAuth actively exploited to drop bots and webshells (CVE-2026-58115). Exploited in the wild.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Strands Agents Tools before 0.8.6: per AWS (CVE-2026-115415), prompt injection could get the environment tool to return env vars unmasked, including API keys. Upgrade to 0.8.6 or remove the environment tool, then rotate keys.

author: DarkControlAI
text: MoLing MCP server CVE-2026-62863 (CVSS 9.6, fixed in 0.5.0): in SSE mode a malicious web page could hijack its session and call its tools, even when bound to localhost.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-63655: Prior to 4.3.1, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server accepts unauthenticated requests.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-76892: Prior to 4.3.1, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server calls JSON.parse on untrusted input.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-76893: Prior to 4.3.2, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server reuses one stateful session.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Researchers observed a supply-chain attack targeting OpenAI Codex users via a malicious GitHub configuration bundle: no executable payload, just natural-language prompt injection silently hijacking the agent's global system prompt.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Malicious versions of the Claude Code VS Code extension were distributed through Cursor's marketplace for 11 hours, exposing up to 5,000 developers to a supply chain attack with reconnaissance, persistence, and SSH backdoor capabilities.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Supply chain attack on cPGuard's update infrastructure pushed a credential-harvesting root shell script to ~2,950 Linux web hosting servers in a 70-minute window.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Railway's preliminary report on the Oct 21 incident: up to about 100,000 workspaces (1.85%) may have had environment variables exposed. Attacker wanted AI and platform API keys. Rotate keys stored there, then redeploy.

author: phantmradar
text: Beget, Russia's No. 2 .RU domain registrar, says attackers got into its infrastructure management systems and wiped VPS, cloud storage and Kubernetes data plus all binary VPS backups. Customers should rotate keys.

author: techie_piyush
text: LiteLLM was hit by a supply chain attack on Oct 21: version 1.107.0 on PyPI and Docker shipped malware that steals environment variables and cloud credentials.

author: Gabriel_kemmer9
text: The Northflank cloud breach detected by Wiz: attackers accessed customer secrets and walked away with live AI API keys and production credentials.

author: JurajCekan
text: Google Mandiant reported on LLMjacking: attackers steal corporate API keys and cloud access to models, then burn through tokens at industrial scale; some victims saw $100k+ bills.

author: tangtangcry0621
text: Binance preliminary report on the $6.34B hack: attackers had been inside since June, a 5-month infiltration before draining funds on October 29.

author: FatimaGulbaloch
text: CERT-In advisory on "CRAFTY FALCON", an AI-powered hacking group using publicly available AI pentest tools from GitHub such as PentAGI and ARTEX to attack targets.

author: theomlondhe
text: CVE-2026-109518: on Debian/Ubuntu, APT can install an attacker .deb as root after a verified download is overwritten through a hard link during HTTP retries. Fixed in apt 3.0.4; mitigate with Retries=0.

author: CipherSecurityN
text: Zyxel has patched CVE-2026-107441, a pre-auth out-of-bounds write in GS1900 switches exploited as a zero-day. GreyNoise saw ~996 devices hit in 48 countries; Binarly found the June CVE-2026-7273 fix didn't stop it.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Google fixes a critical Skia use-after-free in Chrome on Android before 156.0.8078.47 (CVE-2026-113341).

author: CyfirmaR
text: PHP2Shell is being actively exploited: CVE-2026-109618 + CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2) = unauthenticated RCE in PHP core. Updating your CMS does not fix it. CYFIRMA captured a 216-host target list; attribution DPRK/Lazarus-nexus.

author: iamnrdas
text: Critical Kyverno CVE-2026-122310 (CVSS 9.9): namespace-scoped Policy creators can escalate to cluster admin via apiCall urlPath traversal in versions <1.19.2.

author: unitxyz
text: GitBook has confirmed that the incident affecting Unit's documentation originated from a security breach of GitBook's infrastructure.
